title: SS27 Toddler Boys' Little Harbour
summary: Nautical for toddler boys: stripes, sailor collars and navy with red, in soft jersey.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Sailor collars, navy and red were season-defining at Playtime Paris <sup>[1]</sup>; Loir Paris's sailor top was in MilK's selection <sup>[2]</sup>. Most SS27 kidswear sources describe collections across ages and genders. The evidence below is the fair record; the shapes, products and sizes are Forecut's application of it to toddler boys, roughly 1 to 4 years.

design_implications:
- Easy dressing: snaps at the crotch, wide neck openings.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
